item.title: Player of the Game: McDonald's Drew Zajack
item.description: McDonald senior Drew Zajack was named Player of the Game for his efforts in the Blue Devils' 74-51 win over Springfield.

item.title: McDonald coach talks quest for perfect regular season
item.description: Following a 74-51 win over Springfield, McDonald head coach James Franceschelli spoke with Chad Krispinsky.

item.title: Sinkhole damages vehicles in Youngstown
item.description: The Youngstown Water Department responded to a sinkhole on the 500 block of Bennington Avenue, which damaged a pickup truck and a car, causing the road to close between Parker Street and Mackey Avenue.

item.title: Elections Board will not move to downtown building
item.description: The Mahoning County Board of Elections unanimously passed a resolution Tuesday evening stating they will not move into a new Mahoning County administration building being proposed for downtown Youngstown.

item.title: Juvenile identified in Warren fatal shooting
item.description: Da'Mar McKinney, 18, of Youngstown, was killed in a shooting at an apartment complex in Warren, Ohio, and two 18-year-olds have been charged with murder in the case.

item.title: Trial date set for embattled former recovery clinic owner Ryan Sheridan
item.description: Ryan Sheridan, a former addiction-counseling-center operator, has been set for trial next month for felony charges of abduction and domestic violence from an October 2025 incident in Austintown, and is being held on a federal probation violation from his 2019 Medicaid fraud conviction.

item.title: Howland baseball standout headed to college level
item.description: Elliot Gebhardt helped lead Howland to 29 wins over the last two seasons

item.title: Poland Twp. police chief testifies before committee to allow for resource officer at Holy Family
item.description: Poland Township Police Chief Greg Wilson testified Tuesday before the Senate Education Committee in Columbus, urging them to change the law to allow the township to continue providing a student resource police officer to Holy Family Catholic School.

item.title: Statewide quarantine set to deal with spotted lanternflies
item.description: The Ohio Department of Agriculture has issued a statewide quarantine to deal with the spread of spotted lanternflies.

item.title: Area reopens after crash involving police cruiser, three taken to hospital
item.description: Three people were taken to the hospital after a crash involving a police cruiser Tuesday evening in Boardman.
